tg.conclusion: Reviewed Telegram 0.74.0-0.75.0 (0.75.0 on Core 0.350.0/Base 0.47.0): tg guide lists scenarios; tg --help and a bare tg show a short first screen; tg commands prints a text list by section with (writes) marks, options in --json; every command help ends with Returns, Next usually and Example; npm install -g installs the agent skill only when TG_INSTALL_AGENT names an agent (the Windows one-command installer still does by default); QR login uses cli-core loginQr with --qr-file; writes under the read-only lock or a readonly profile refuse before connecting; 0.75.0 fixes the setup QR step order, restores Global Options in setup --help, names the profile in hints and adds line to next steps. Changed native pages: archive, attachments, bot, changelog, cli-contract link, commands, compare, configuration, configuration-reference, diagnostics, groups, limits, mcp, people, query-language, recipes, remote, replies, search, security, sessions, topic-search, troubleshooting, usage; RU/ES updated. Corrections: the troubleshooting exit-code correction is retired (the source now says exit 2); the bot moderation joins correction now also covers the new Returns line; a new correction quotes --qr-file <png> in a troubleshooting heading; the getFile URL correction stays. Roadmap unchanged.

max.conclusion: Reviewed MAX 0.63.0 (Core 0.347.0/Base 0.46.0): max guide lists four scenarios; max --help shows a short first screen and max help options / --help-all keep the full help; max commands prints a text list by section, options in --json; every command help ends with Returns, Next usually and Example; npm install -g no longer installs the agent skill unless MAX_INSTALL_AGENT is set; a mistyped profile no longer creates a profile; MAX_READ_ONLY and readonly levels refuse before connecting, --dry-run no longer approves a refused write, and max mcp offers no MAX writes under the lock. Changed native pages: changelog, cli-contract, commands, configuration-reference, diagnostics, groups, limits, mcp, recipes, remote, search, security, sessions, topic-search, troubleshooting, and release links in bot/usage; EN/ES (and RU commands) updated. Roadmap unchanged. No newer max release was on npm after waiting 90 minutes.

zm.conclusion: Reviewed Zoom 0.28.0-0.29.0 with Core 0.348.0/Base 0.47.0: zm guide [name] ships five scenarios; zm --help shows a short first screen; zm commands prints a text list by section (options in --json); every leaf --help ends with Returns, Next usually and Example; ZM_READ_ONLY=1 refuses changes to Zoom, the login, settings and added data with exit 5 while reads and syncs still run, and refuses remote semantic MCP queries; session status reports state: saved; new ZM_STATE_DIR, ZM_CACHE_DIR and WIRECAT_STATE_DIR. Changed native pages: changelog, commands, configuration, installation, roadmap, search, security, sessions; RU/ES updated. The portal correction for memo examples in search is retired: the released page has the corrected commands. Roadmap reviewed: only the Memo version number was removed; broader reviewed meeting preparation remains planned and is not shipped.
